subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should install-time `HOOK.md` metadata be contractually limited to regular files of at most 1 MiB, while the sibling workspace path retains its root-scoped opener and skip behavior?
rationale: The mitigation is technically sound, but current documentation and tests do not establish the supported size, symlink, or cross-path failure contract; automation should not choose that permanent boundary.

options.title: Adopt the strict contract
options.body: Accept regular `HOOK.md` files up to 1 MiB as supported and align sibling limits and tests while retaining each entry point's intended error handling.

options.title: Preserve safe aliases
options.body: Use a bounded root-scoped opener for installation if within-root symlinked metadata must remain supported.

recommendation.title: Adopt the strict contract
recommendation.body: Accept regular `HOOK.md` files up to 1 MiB as supported and align sibling limits and tests while retaining each entry point's intended error handling.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work established the closest sibling hook metadata boundary and touched the install path.
